[Skip to main content](https://supportgowhere.life.gov.sg/schemes/I0ZPVBeU/tax-payment-support#main-content) # Tax Payment Support - SupportGoWhere Tax Payment Support Share link Supports eligible individuals in their tax payments through various payment arrangements such as longer GIRO-based instalment plans. SCHEME HIGHLIGHTS - Enables longer payment plans for applicants experiencing difficulties in paying their taxes - Grants retirees the Extended Giro Scheme for Residential Property (Retirees), offering longer instalment plans for tax payment [Apply now](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/login/selection) Expand all sections About this support - Longer instalment plans may be made available for individuals or businesses facing financial challenges or other extenuating circumstances - Eligible retirees may apply for the Extended Giro Scheme for Residential Property (Retirees), which provides a longer instalment plan of up to 24 months for property tax payment Who is this for? For individuals who experience unexpected or extenuating circumstances due to the following: - Financial issues - High medical expenses - Loss of employment or income - Lawsuits - You may be required to submit documentary evidence to support your request for a longer instalment plan For retirees: - To be eligible for the Extended Giro Scheme for Residential Property (Retirees), applicants must meet all the following conditions: - You are residing in the property (and taxed at owner-occupier tax rates) - Your assessable income for Year of Assessment 2023 does not exceed $34,000 - All property owners, including yourself, are aged 65 or above in 2024 - There is outstanding property tax payable for the property If applicants cease to be eligible, their extended instalment plan will be reverted to the standard instalment plan How to apply? | For individuals: | - Apply for an extended instalment plan via the 'Apply for Payment Plan' digital service through the IRAS [myTax Portal](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/)

- Please note that instalment plans are only available with GIRO
- For existing GIRO users, cancel your current plan and set up a new one. You may refer to this guide on [cancelling and reactivating GIRO for detailed instructions](https://www.iras.gov.sg/media/docs/default-source/uploadedfiles/pdf/steps-to-cancel-and-reactivate-giro---enf-webpages@18feb2020.pdf?sfvrsn=fbc17716_5)

- For applicants without a GIRO arrangement for Individual Income and Property Tax, you may apply for GIRO (with a DBS / POSB or OCBC bank account) via [myTax Portal](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/) and set up your new plan online. Refer to [this guide](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/property-tax/property-owners/payments/experiencing-difficulties-in-paying-your-tax) for detailed instructions | | For businesses without an existing GIRO arrangement for Corporate Income Tax, Property Tax and Goods and Services Tax: | - Apply for GIRO with a DBS / POSB, OCBC, UOB, Bank of China or Maybank account via the IRAS [myTax Portal](https://mytax.iras.gov.sg/)

- Arrange a new plan

- Alternatively, [you may refer to this guide for the detailed steps](https://www.iras.gov.sg/media/docs/default-source/uploadedfiles/pdf/eservice-user-guide_apply-for-payment-plan_non-individuals_2023-11.pdf?sfvrsn=31c2fac6_3) | Where you do not have account with any of the participating banks listed above, you may: - Fill up [this form](https://form.gov.sg/673c038018eb14d441d54153) to request for GIRO application form - View on applying GIRO [here](https://www.iras.gov.sg/quick-links/payments/giro-individual-income-tax) Please refer to [IRAS’ site on alternative tax payment plans for more details](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/property-tax/property-owners/payments/experiencing-difficulties-in-paying-your-tax) Where can I find help? [View more details](https://www.iras.gov.sg/taxes/property-tax/property-owners/payments/experiencing-difficulties-in-paying-your-tax) * * * IRAS hotline: [1800-356-8300](tel:1800-356-8300) Airtime charges apply for mobile calls to 1800 service lines. Calls are free of charge only if made from regular land lines in Singapore. * * * [Submit an enquiry](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/property-tax) * * * [Visit your nearest branch](https://www.iras.gov.sg/contact-us/locate-us) Scheme last updated 23 Sep 2025 Try our AI search
